1948 C.A.F. RHYS DAVIDS note en tête de son article « The fellowman in Yoga » : « There are few words
more rich in meaning than the word Yoga. It covers a wide and long field of Indian culture ; it
covers several aspects of that field. Hence the interpreter, who belongs to a different field of
culture, has to use more than any one term for it. » (« The fellowman in Yoga » in Yoga.
Internationale Zeitschrift für wissenschaftliche Yoga-Forschung, p. 75.) Sur l'emploi védique du mot
yo≠ga, voir L. Renou « Quelques termes du Ṛgveda : a.Abhva. b. Ba≠ndhu. c. Pra≠siti. d.Yo≠ga.
